entries.english: Feudal matters and vassal services of the Lords von Rosenberg, spanning 1569–1603, 1612, and 1630–1631. The volume contains: summonses to attend feudal courts issued by the bishops of Würzburg (1570–1586), the Markgraf von Brandenburg-Ansbach (1591–1603), Graf Wolfgang von Hohenlohe-Weikersheim (1595), and Graf Konrad von Castell (1576); summonses to render service issued by the Bischof von Würzburg (1589–1593), the Markgraf von Brandenburg-Ansbach (1591–1599 and 1612), and the Counts of Hohenlohe (1591–1595); requests by the Lords von Rosenberg for enfeoffment with their Hohenlohe fiefs when a fief-holder died (1576–1582); Zaisolf von Rosenberg’s 1569 request to Graf Eberhard von Hohenlohe-Waldenburg for enfeoffment after the death of Graf Ludwig Kasimir von Hohenlohe-Neuenstein; Albrecht Christoph von Rosenberg’s 1630–1631 request to Graf Georg Friedrich von Hohenlohe-Weikersheim after the death of Georg Siegmund von Rosenberg; and the Lords von Rosenberg’s 1582 request to Graf Heinrich von Castell following the death of Konrad von Rosenberg der Ältere. One volume.
